title: Canopy spec conformance case
description: One validation case. An implementation feeds `screen` to its validator and compares the outcome with `valid` (level 1) and `errors` (level 2).

errors.description: Present exactly when `valid` is false. Each expected error must appear among the errors the implementation reports; extra reported errors are allowed.

rule.description: `schema` for a JSON Schema failure, otherwise a semantic rule id from the README.

instancePath.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the failing location in `screen`; "" is the document root.
